messages:
ashley: Heads-up — deploybot is spiking on sticky prober failures for the v2 canary. Seeing ~5 tenants with repeated probe timeouts. Thinking we should discuss pausing the cutover and a kill-switch threshold. @ops-oncall any immediate concerns?

deploybot: [alert] 3581234567: canary-prober: 5 tenants failing healthcheck for 3 consecutive probes. Auto-escalation enabled. /deploy status canary -> FAILED_PROBERS=5

mike: On it. Which probe? long-context stream probe or short JSON schema probe?

ashley: short-json-schema probe. Failures look like 422/timeout combos, not consistent 503s.

eva: Could be client SDK validation hitting new strict schema in v2. Any client-side errors in logs?

mike: Pulling logs now. Early glance: several requests show payloads with old optional fields still present -> v2 strict contract rejects. Tenant IDs: 4231, 9082, 1120.

sam: That sounds like compatibility break. We should pin those tenants to v1 routing immediately while we triage. Can ops perform a quick pin list update?

ops-oncall: We can do temporary pinning. Proposed steps: 1) Pause canary traffic (kill-switch) if failing tenants >= 3 for 5m. 2) Pin affected tenant IDs to v1. 3) Notify client-facing release notes + SDK owners. Agreed?

ashley: +1 to steps. Also want a rollback criteria checklist: if pinning fixes errors within 10m -> proceed with staggered unpause; else full rollback of this cutover.

deploybot: Command to pause canary: `/deploybot pause-route --route v2-canary --reason "prober-failure-short-json"`

ops-oncall: Executing pause now. Running pin update for tenants [4231,9082,1120] -> `/routes pin --tenant 4231 --to v1; /routes pin --tenant 9082 --to v1; /routes pin --tenant 1120 --to v1`

deploybot: Done: canary paused at 3581234780 by ops-oncall. Pins applied for 4231,9082,1120. Health checks will re-evaluate.

mike: Logs after pin show those tenants now routed to v1 and successful probes. One remaining failing tenant (3310) shows encoded array shape mismatch to v2.

eva: I'll open a quick note in the release docs: add migration note about removed optional-field `meta.client_mode` and link SDK change. Whoever owns SDK: @sam please coordinate patch and release note blurb.

sam: Will patch SDK validation and cut a micro patch release. ETA 90m. In the meantime, recommend we hold cutover until SDK patch is out and release notes updated.

ashley: Sounds good. Final decision: keep canary paused, keep pins for affected tenants, add note to release channel and release notes with rollback rationale. If more than 2 new failing tenants appear during hold -> escalate to full rollback of the staged cutover.

ops-oncall: Ack. Posting a short message to #release-notes and #customers-ops.

deploybot: deploybot note: scheduled unpause window cleared. Manual unpause required after triage.

ashley: Thanks team. I'll draft the release note bullet and paste here for signoff before we publish.

eva: Thx. Quick checklist for postmortem: record probe thresholds, affected tenant IDs, SDK versions, and timeline of pin/unpin actions.

mike: Adding logs -> https://logs.company.local/trace/3581234567 (ops access only)

ashley: End of thread — keeping pinned until SDK micro-release. Will follow up with a short postmortem after patch and unpin.
